issue_snapshot.title: Follow-ups from #55: 2 from QA
issue_snapshot.body:
What the review and QA of PR #56 (for #55) found and did not fix there — filed as it merged, one ticket for the lot. ## Found by QA — pre-existing PR #56 did not introduce these, which is why they did not block it. ### Remove-member confirm open widens members page past 375px viewport **Severity** minor (as judged by QA — reassess before planning). **Expected.** > With the remove confirm expanded on the members page, the page fits the 375px viewport (scrollWidth <= clientWidth) while the question names its member and group in full. **Actual.** > With the remove confirm expanded, documentElement.scrollWidth reads 390 against clientWidth 375 — with 80-character names (T-3) and with short names (T-14) alike. The confirm question itself wraps correctly; the row around it does not fit: the confirm renders as an in-flow w-64 (256px, shrink-0) dropdown inside the member row, and 256px of dropdown plus avatar plus gaps exceeds the ~309px card content width, so the row pushes the document ~15px past the viewport until Cancel. **Steps to reproduce** 1. Sign up a fresh account and create any group (short names reproduce it; 80-char names are not required). 2. Add any placeholder seat from the members page. 3. Open the seat row overflow menu and press Remove to expand the confirm. 4. Read document.documentElement.scrollWidth vs clientWidth at a 375px viewport: 390 vs 375. **Suspected cause.** > Row geometry untouched by this PR: MemberRow renders the confirm in a div.mt-2.w-64.max-w-[calc(100vw-3rem)] inside details.relative.shrink-0 (components/groups-panels.tsx MemberRow), so the 256px dropdown cannot shrink inside the ~309px Card content width (Card p-4 inside main px-4 at 375px). The PR diff adds only break-words to the shared question

and never touches MemberRow (verified: the groups-panels.tsx hunk touches ClaimSeatForm/JoinPanel only); the T-14 short-name control overflows identically, so the defect predates the PR. The fix belongs with the row (e.g. an overlay dropdown or a narrower panel), not with the wrapping classes. **Reproducible:** always ### Group page balance row with an 80-character seat name widens the page to 753px at 375px **Severity** minor (as judged by QA — reassess before planning). **Expected.** > The group page fits a 375px viewport (scrollWidth <= clientWidth) when a member with an 80-character unbroken name owes money. **Actual.** > document scrollWidth is 753 vs clientWidth 375: the " owes you ₹60.00" row (li.flex.flex-wrap > span.text-body.text-lent in the balances section) has no overflow-wrap treatment. **Steps to reproduce** 1. Sign up and create any group. 2. On the members page add a seat named "z" repeated 80 times. 3. Add an expense of 120 split equally (paid by you). 4. Open /groups/ at a 375px viewport and read document.documentElement.scrollWidth: 753. **Suspected cause.** > app/groups/[id]/page.tsx balance list renders the member name in a span.text-body without break-words/min-w-0; the PR diff does not touch that file (same shape as the spots the PR fixes elsewhere). **Reproducible:** always --- **Check each one still reproduces before planning it.** They were written against the PR as it stood, and a later round can have fixed one. Some may not hold up: say so and drop them rather than implementing something that was never wrong. Split this if they turn out to be unrelated. Depends on #55.

validated_work_order.understanding: Issue #60 holds two QA follow-ups from PR #56 and says to re-check each before planning. Item 1 (remove confirm on the members page widens the document to 390px at 375px) is already fixed on main: components/groups-panels.tsx:692 renders the owner's confirm panel as `absolute right-0 z-40 mt-2 w-64 max-w-[calc(100vw-3rem)] ...` inside `details.relative.shrink-0`, and app/overflow-wrap.test.ts:317-321 asserts `absolute` on it. The ticket's 'in-flow w-64' describes the build before #56's final round (commit 47b6b90), so item 1 is dropped, not re-implemented. Item 2 still holds in the source: app/groups/[id]/page.tsx:546-550 renders `transferWords(transfer, membership.id)` ('<80 z's> owes you') in `<span className={`text-body ${directionTone(...)}`}>` with no wrap treatment, a flex item of `li.flex.flex-wrap.items-baseline.justify-between`. An unbroken 80-char seat name (PLACEHOLDER_NAME_MAX) gives that span an automatic min-content floor of about 700px, which propagates up through the Card and sets the 753px document width. transferWords has exactly one call site (page.tsx:549). The failing element was not measured in a browser by the planner; the source evidence plus QA's report identify it.
validated_work_order.root_cause: The name span in the summary card's transfer row is a flex item whose automatic minimum width equals its min-content (the whole unbroken name); overflow-wrap cannot lower that floor, so the row, Card and document grow to 753px.
validated_work_order.approach: One-element class fix. On the name span add `min-w-0 break-words` so the long name wraps onto its own line of the flex-wrap row (its max-content exceeds the container), flex-shrink then shrinks it to the container because min-width is 0, and break-words breaks the unbroken name inside it. `min-w-0` is required because overflow-wrap alone does not reduce a flex item's automatic minimum size (conventions.md). On the amount span add `ml-auto` so that when the name takes a line to itself the amount sits right-aligned beneath it, as ui.md requires for amounts in lists (justify-between leaves a lone item flush left); on the one-line case ml-auto is a no-op. Short names render identically. Sentences wrap rather than truncate (conventions.md: only list rows truncate), so the direction words stay readable. No shared component changes. Add a source-level regression test next to the page (the page is an async Server Component starting with a session read, so nothing renders it; amounts-tabular.test.ts is the precedent and documents the limit) and state plainly that pixel width is proven only by the browser AC. Item 1 is dropped on the source evidence; the browser check of it is a confirmation, and must first verify the preview serves the current build (qa/environment.md) so a stale :3000 build showing 390 is not read as a regression.

files.change: In the summary card transfer list (~lines 546-557): change the name span className from `text-body ${directionTone(transfer, membership.id)}` to `min-w-0 break-words text-body ${directionTone(transfer, membership.id)}`, and the amount span (the one with data-amount) className from `font-semibold tabular-nums ${directionTone(...)}` to `ml-auto font-semibold tabular-nums ${directionTone(...)}`. Leave the li and everything else untouched. Optionally a one-line comment: min-w-0 because overflow-wrap cannot lower a flex item's automatic min-content size; ml-auto keeps the amount right when the name takes the line.
files.why: This is the element QA identified (li.flex.flex-wrap > span.text-body.text-lent) and the only one carrying a member name without wrap treatment in the default tab; ml-auto keeps the amount right-aligned per docs/ui.md when the row wraps.

cases: page.tsx source: the opening tag of the span wrapping `{transferWords(transfer, membership.id)}` has `min-w-0` and `break-words` in its className (located by reading back from the transferWords call to the previous `<span`, scanning the template-literal className like amounts-tabular.test.ts's classesAt)
the same span still carries `text-body` and the `directionTone(transfer, membership.id)` interpolation, so direction colour is not lost
the amount span following it (the `data-amount` in the transfer row) keeps `tabular-nums` and `font-semibold` and gains `ml-auto`, so a wrapped amount stays right-aligned
transferWords(...) appears exactly once in the page source (guards that the one fixed call site is the only one)

acceptance.check: With a placeholder seat named 'z' x 80 who owes the viewer money (seat added, expense of 120 split equally and paid by the viewer), the group page /groups/<id> at a 375px viewport has documentElement.scrollWidth <= clientWidth (was 753 vs 375).
acceptance.how_to_verify: Confirm the server serves the branch build first (build-id probe in qa/environment.md, or a fresh build on a spare port). Sign up, create a group, add a seat named 'z' x 80 on the members page, add expense 120 equal split paid by you, open /groups/<id> at 375x812 and read document.documentElement.scrollWidth and clientWidth.

acceptance.check: The long transfer line names its member in full ('<80 z's> owes you' present unclipped, wrapped across lines, no ellipsis) and the amount (e.g. ₹60.00) is visible and right-aligned within the card, whether beside or beneath the name.
acceptance.how_to_verify: Same page as AC-1; read the summary card's transfer li text content, take a 375px screenshot, and check the amount span's right edge sits at the card content's right edge.

acceptance.check: With ordinary names (a short one like 'Bo' and a 25-30 character one) the transfer line renders as before: name words left and amount right on one row where they fit, direction colour unchanged (text-lent for 'owes you', text-owed for 'You owe'); the reverse direction ('You owe <80 z's>') also fits 375px.
acceptance.how_to_verify: Seat 'Bo' owing 60, compare the summary row at 375px and 1280px. Repeat with a ~28-char name. Then have the seat pay an expense so the viewer owes the 80-char seat and read scrollWidth vs clientWidth.

acceptance.check: The new source-level test passes on the fixed page and fails when `break-words`, `min-w-0` or `ml-auto` is removed; typecheck, test:ci and build (sdlc:verify) pass.
acceptance.how_to_verify: npm run sdlc:verify; temporarily drop each class and run the new test to see it fail.

acceptance.check: Ticket item 1 is confirmed not reproducing on a build of this branch: with the remove confirm expanded on the members page at 375px, scrollWidth <= clientWidth for a short and an 80-char name, and the question still names member and group in full.
acceptance.how_to_verify: On a verified-current build (not a stale :3000 preview), sign up, create a group, add a seat, open its overflow menu, press Remove, read scrollWidth vs clientWidth at 375px. Report as not reproducing; no code change is expected. A 390 on a stale preview is an environment finding, not a regression.

qa_script: First confirm the server under test serves this branch's build (build-id probe from qa/environment.md, or serve a fresh build on a spare port).
Sign up a fresh account and create a group (any name, INR).
On the members page add a seat named 'z' repeated 80 times.
Add an expense of 120 split equally between you and that seat, paid by you.

At 375x812 open /groups/<id> (default Expenses tab); read document.documentElement.scrollWidth and clientWidth (expect scrollWidth <= clientWidth) and the summary card's transfer row text (full 80-char name plus 'owes you', amount ₹60.00 visible and right-aligned).
Open the Balances, Activity and Members tabs at 375px and repeat the width read; report any width above 375 as a new finding naming the widest element rather than fixing it here.
Reverse direction: add an expense paid by the 80-char seat so the viewer owes it; confirm the 'You owe <name>' row fits 375px.
Repeat with a short seat name ('Bo') and a ~28-char name: one row, name left, amount right at 375px and 1280px.
Item 1 re-check: on /groups/<id>/members at 375px open the seat's overflow menu, press Remove, read scrollWidth vs clientWidth with the confirm expanded (expect 375/375), then Cancel.

alternatives_considered.approach: Also rework MemberRow's remove-confirm geometry (narrower panel or full-width sheet) for item 1.
alternatives_considered.rejected_because: Already fixed on main (absolute panel at groups-panels.tsx:692, asserted by app/overflow-wrap.test.ts); the ticket says to drop items that no longer reproduce.

alternatives_considered.approach: A shared NameText component or break-words/min-w-0 added to ListRow/Card for every name on the page.
alternatives_considered.rejected_because: One call site is wrong; ListRow already truncates with the full value in title. An abstraction with one caller is unwarranted, and page-wide overflow-x:hidden would clip content.

alternatives_considered.approach: `truncate` plus `title` on the transfer-words span like list rows.
alternatives_considered.rejected_because: The line is a sentence whose point is who owes whom; ellipsis could clip the direction words. conventions.md: sentences wrap, list rows truncate.
overflow-wrap does not lower a flex item's automatic min-content width, so the page would stay wide (conventions.md, issue #49's replan).

alternatives_considered.approach: Extract the transfer row into a small component so renderToStaticMarkup can render it in the test.
alternatives_considered.rejected_because: Would add a component and a refactor for a one-span fix; renderToStaticMarkup proves classes, not pixel width, so it buys little over the source-level precedent. Width is proven by AC-1.

assumptions: Item 1 is fixed on main, established from source and the existing test, not a browser measurement by the planner; AC-5 has QA confirm on a verified-current build.
The transfer span is the widest element in the default tab for this repro; once fixed another element in a different tab could become the next widest, which the QA walk reads and reports separately.
Wrapping the amount under the name on narrow screens is accepted for the degenerate 80-char case.
unknowns: Whether the Activity and Members tabs on the group page widen at 375px with an 80-char seat name; outside this ticket and not in QA's report.
Exact pixel result in Chromium; the cold-render tests prove classes only, the browser ACs cover width.
risks: A source-level test is brittle to JSX reformatting and cannot detect width; it locates the span by the transferWords call, states its limit in its header, and AC-1 is the only proof of pixel width.
The summary card's long names wrap while Balances-tab list rows truncate; intentional per conventions.md but QA might note the inconsistency.
conventions.md's note that the #55 follow-ups are in flight is the Librarian's to update; no .sdlc/memory, docs or .github path is touched.
out_of_scope: Re-implementing the members-page remove-confirm overlay (already on main).
Any other long-name surface not named in the ticket, including other tabs found wide during the QA walk.
Changes to shared components in components/ui.tsx.
evidence: components/groups-panels.tsx:692 — `absolute right-0 z-40 mt-2 w-64 max-w-[calc(100vw-3rem)]` panel inside details.relative.shrink-0.
app/overflow-wrap.test.ts:317-321 asserts the owner's confirm panel contains `absolute`; :367 asserts the non-owner root does not.

app/groups/[id]/page.tsx:541-557 — transfer li `flex flex-wrap items-baseline justify-between gap-2`; name span `text-body ${directionTone(...)}` with no break-words/min-w-0; amount span has no ml-auto.
grep: transferWords is defined at page.tsx:1040 and called only at page.tsx:549.
docs/ui.md:77 — amount right-aligned in list rows; conventions.md:27-32 — names wrap with break-words and min-w-0 at each flex level.
qa/environment.md — the :3000 preview lags the branch, so a stale build can still show 390 for item 1.
validated_work_order.confidence_rationale: The failing element, its call-site uniqueness and the idiom are verified in source and match QA's selector; item 1's dismissal rests on source plus an existing passing assertion, not a browser measurement. It would drop if the browser walk finds another element setting the width after the span is fixed, or rise to the 90s once AC-1 and AC-5 are measured on a verified-current build.
validated_work_order.debate_summary: The critic called the plan sound and raised one major and three minor findings; there was no dispute about the diagnosis. Accepted: (a) AC-5 and the QA script must verify the build under test before reading item 1's width, since the preview lags the branch, and item 1 is dropped on source evidence with the browser check demoted to confirmation; (b) the amount can land flush left when the name takes its own line, so ml-auto on the amount span is added, with AC-2 requiring right alignment and a test case; (c) the proposal's wording that min-w-0 'clamps the hypothetical size' was wrong: the item wraps because its max-content exceeds the container, then shrinks because min-width is 0, and the plan now says so. Accepted partly: the test is weak (class presence only); I kept it as repo precedent, dropped the non-test 'header comment' case in favour of a real once-only call-site case, and said plainly that AC-1 alone proves width; I rejected extracting a component for renderToStaticMarkup as disproportionate. Rejected: nothing wholesale. The critic's extra edge cases (reverse direction, 25-30 char names) were folded into AC-3 and the QA script; double-long-name transfers, CJK/emoji names, over-TRANSFER_LINES lists and very wide amounts are left to the QA walk as residual risk, because the same two classes govern them. No decision in brief.md applied (none recorded).
residual_risks: Pixel width is proven only by the browser ACs; the unit test checks class names.

Unexercised in the walk unless QA adds them: two 80-char names in one transfer, CJK/emoji/symbol-only 80-char names, more than TRANSFER_LINES long-name transfers, and a very wide amount beside a long name.
Other tabs of the group page (Balances, Activity, Members) may be wider than 375px with an 80-char seat name; not in QA's report and out of scope, to be filed if found.
Item 1 was dropped without a planner-run browser measurement; a stale preview could make QA see 390 and mis-file it.
